purpose: Read-only reinspection of archived core desktop/Android-host XML and held input hashes
command:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import hashlib,json,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
base=Path('docs/development/evidence')
gradle=base/'gradle'
name='second-io-perm-and-fourth-ui'
receipt_path=gradle/(name+'.log.result.json')
summary_path=gradle/(name+'.summary.json')
inputs_path=gradle/(name+'.inputs.json')
log_path=gradle/(name+'.log')
receipt=json.loads(receipt_path.read_text());summary=json.loads(summary_path.read_text());inputs=json.loads(inputs_path.read_text())
assert receipt['exit_code']==summary['exit_code']==1
assert summary['input_hashes_unchanged'] and not summary['changed_inputs']
log=log_path.read_text()
assert '> Task :calf-permissions:calf-permissions-core:desktopTest' in log.splitlines()
assert '> Task :calf-permissions:calf-permissions-core:testAndroidHostTest' in log.splitlines()
assert '> Task :calf-file-picker:compileAndroidHostTest FAILED' in log.splitlines()
assert 'BUILD FAILED' in log
archived={r['path']:r for r in summary['reports']}
started=datetime.fromisoformat(receipt['started_utc'])
reports=[];targets={}
for path in sorted((gradle/name/'reports/calf-permissions').rglob('TEST-*.xml')):
    xml=ET.parse(path).getroot();sha=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert archived[str(path)]['sha256']==sha,path
    counts={k:int(xml.get(k,'0')) for k in ('tests','failures','errors','skipped')}
    assert counts['tests']==len(xml.findall('testcase'))
    assert counts['failures']==counts['errors']==counts['skipped']==0
    for tag in ('failure','error','skipped'):assert not list(xml.iter(tag))
    timestamp=datetime.fromisoformat(xml.get('timestamp').replace('Z','+00:00'))
    assert started<=timestamp<=started+timedelta(seconds=receipt['elapsed_seconds']+1),path
    for key,count in counts.items():assert int(archived[str(path)][key])==count
    target=path.parent.name
    aggregate=targets.setdefault(target,dict(tests=0,failures=0,errors=0,skipped=0,reports=0))
    for key,count in counts.items():aggregate[key]+=count
    aggregate['reports']+=1
    reports.append(dict(path=str(path),sha256=sha,name=xml.get('name'),timestamp=xml.get('timestamp'),target=target,**counts,test_cases=[c.get('name') for c in xml.findall('testcase')]))
assert len(reports)==8
assert targets['desktopTest']==dict(tests=24,failures=0,errors=0,skipped=0,reports=3)
assert targets['testAndroidHostTest']==dict(tests=41,failures=0,errors=0,skipped=0,reports=5)
for target,counts in targets.items():assert summary['modules']['calf-permissions/core:'+target]==counts
permission_inputs={p:h for p,h in inputs['files'].items() if p.startswith('calf-permissions/')}
assert len(inputs['files'])==283 and len(permission_inputs)==30
assert all(Path(p).is_file() and hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in permission_inputs.items())
checkpoint_path=base/'PERM-checkpoint-after-host-fixture.json'
held=json.loads(checkpoint_path.read_text())['source_sha256']
current={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in Path('calf-permissions').rglob('*.kt') if '/src/' in str(p)}
assert held==current and len(current)==142
print(json.dumps(dict(
    reviewed_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),scope='Permission core desktop and Android-host only; not device privacy UI',
    base_commit=summary['base_commit'],source_state=summary['source_state'],
    command=receipt['command'],started_utc=receipt['started_utc'],elapsed_seconds=receipt['elapsed_seconds'],
    overall_exit_code=1,overall_result='FAILED from unrelated calf-file-picker Android-host test compilation; all 260 executed cases in the combined run passed, but not a successful combined build',
    permission_result='Core tasks succeeded: 24 desktop + 41 Android-host executions, 0 failures/errors/skips, 8 fresh XML reports',
    totals=dict(tests=65,failures=0,errors=0,skipped=0,reports=8),targets=targets,reports=reports,
    command_receipt=str(receipt_path),summary_evidence=str(summary_path),input_manifest=str(inputs_path),log_evidence=str(log_path),
    evidence_sha256={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (receipt_path,summary_path,inputs_path,log_path)},
    root_reported_selected_inputs_unchanged_during_run=True,root_selected_input_count=len(inputs['files']),
    independently_matched_permission_input_count=len(permission_inputs),permission_input_mismatches=[],
    source_hold_check=dict(checkpoint=str(checkpoint_path),kotlin_files=len(current),changed_files=[]),
    verified_scenarios=[
        '24 common core cases passed on desktop and again on Android-host; these repeat the same logical scenarios, not 48 distinct tests.',
        'All 3 shared Compose callback-holder bodies passed under the new non-Android and Robolectric Android wrappers with original assertions unchanged.',
        '12 Android registry/planner/runner cases passed using explicit SDK/grant inputs.',
        '5 public Android factory cases passed under SDK34 Robolectric with real AndroidX ActivityResult registration/contract parsing, injected result intents and LifecycleRegistry events.',
        'Actual Android factory cases cover delayed latest callbacks/state-before-delivery, alias/synthetic batch fanout, empty batches, revocation on resume/disposal, and replacement of a pending permission owner.'
    ],
    limitations=[
        'Injected ActivityResult replies and Robolectric application grants do not display OS privacy dialogs or verify emulator/device authorization.',
        'No physical Android API/target-SDK/manifest matrix, process-kill recreation, Apple native adapters/linking/device behavior, JS/Wasm browser execution or binary compatibility certification.',
        'The ten feature modules were not rerun in this command; their 48 earlier desktop cases remain separate dated evidence.',
        'Owner-held uncommitted diagnostic snapshot, not immutable release evidence; finding statuses partially-verified only and no issue closures.'
    ]),indent=2))
